The name Hayam serves as a constant reminder of Allah's power and mercy in granting us life, as well as our responsibility to make the most of our existence. Additionally, it is a symbol of the permanence of the soul, which transcends physical life. The name Hayam inspires Muslims to strive for a purposeful and meaningful life, in accordance with Islamic principles.
